title: Dorado Basecalling Pipeline - Parameters
description: Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for Oxford Nanopore Dorado basecalling.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to directory containing POD5 files or barcode subfolders.
input.help_text: The pipeline auto-detects structure: if subdirectories are present each is processed as a separate parallel job; otherwise the whole directory is treated as a single sample.

basecalling_options.title: Basecalling options
basecalling_options.description: Options controlling the Dorado basecalling model and core behaviour.

model.description: Basecalling accuracy level or full versioned model name.
model.help_text: Shorthand: 'fast' (fastest), 'hac' (high accuracy, recommended), 'sup' (super accuracy). Full model names are also accepted, e.g. 'dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_hac@v5.0.0'. Dorado resolves shorthand names against the POD5 metadata automatically.

modified_bases.description: Comma-separated list of modified base models to detect.
modified_bases.help_text: Examples: '5mCG_5hmCG' (CpG methylation and hydroxymethylation), '5mCG_5hmCG,6mA' (combined), '5mC_5hmC', '6mA'. Modification models are automatically paired with the chosen simplex model.

models_directory.description: Local directory to search for or cache downloaded models.
models_directory.help_text: Can also be set via the DORADO_MODELS_DIRECTORY environment variable. Useful for offline HPC environments.

min_qscore.description: Minimum mean Q-score threshold. Reads below this value are discarded.
min_qscore.help_text: 0 disables filtering. Common values: 8 (standard), 10 (high quality). Filtered reads are written to a separate 'failed' output when using --output-dir mode.

estimate_poly_a.help_text: Estimates the length of poly-A (and poly-T on the reverse strand) tails. Results are stored in the 'pt' BAM tag.

recursive.description: Recursively scan the input directory for POD5 files.
recursive.help_text: Useful when POD5 files are spread across nested subdirectories. When combined with the per-subdir parallelism of this pipeline, set recursive=false and let Nextflow manage the parallelism instead.

read_ids.description: Path to a newline-delimited file of read IDs to basecall.
read_ids.help_text: Only reads whose IDs appear in this file will be processed. Useful for targeted re-basecalling.

max_reads.description: Maximum number of reads to basecall.
max_reads.help_text: Hard cap on reads processed per job. Useful for testing or subsampling.

resume_from.description: Path to an existing partial BAM to resume basecalling from.
resume_from.help_text: Dorado will skip reads that already appear in this BAM, allowing interrupted jobs to be restarted efficiently.

emit_moves.description: Write the signal move table to the 'mv' BAM tag.
emit_moves.help_text: Required by downstream tools that operate on the raw signal, such as Remora for modified base calling on existing data.

emit_summary.description: Write a sequencing_summary.txt file during basecalling.
emit_summary.help_text: Generates a per-read summary file inline. An additional summary TSV is always produced by the DORADO_SUMMARY process after basecalling.

output_format_options.title: Output format options
output_format_options.description: Control the output file format. Mutually exclusive; default is BAM.

emit_fastq.description: Output reads as FASTQ instead of BAM.
emit_fastq.help_text: FASTQ does not retain alignment information or extended tags (methylation, barcodes, move table). Summary and demux steps are skipped when this is enabled.

emit_sam.description: Output reads as SAM instead of BAM.

emit_cram.description: Output reads as CRAM instead of BAM.
emit_cram.help_text: CRAM provides better compression than BAM. Requires a reference for optimal compression.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Inline alignment to a reference genome during basecalling (via minimap2).

reference.description: Path to reference FASTA, FASTQ, or pre-built .mmi index for inline alignment.
reference.help_text: When provided, Dorado pipes basecalled reads through minimap2 internally, producing aligned BAM output. Avoids a separate dorado aligner step.

bed_file.description: BED file of genomic regions. Overlap counts are written to the 'bh' BAM tag.

mm2_opts.description: Custom minimap2 options, overriding the default 'lr:hq' preset.
mm2_opts.help_text: Example: '-k 15 -w 10'. Quote the value when passing on the command line: --mm2_opts '-k 15 -w 10'

trimming_options.title: Trimming options
trimming_options.description: Control adapter and primer trimming of basecalled reads.

trim.description: Trimming mode: adapters (default), all, or none.
trim.help_text: 'adapters' trims sequencing adapters only. 'all' also trims primers and barcodes. 'none' disables all trimming. Note: when --kit_name is set, trimming is automatically disabled during basecalling to preserve barcodes for the demultiplexing step.

no_trim.description: Explicitly disable all trimming (equivalent to --trim none).

demultiplexing_options.title: Barcode demultiplexing options
demultiplexing_options.description: Classify and split reads by barcode. Basecalling classifies reads inline; a separate DORADO_DEMUX step splits the output BAM into per-barcode files.

barcode_both_ends.description: Require a barcode on both ends of the read for classification.
barcode_both_ends.help_text: Increases classification confidence at the cost of fewer classified reads.

barcode_arrangement.description: Path to a custom barcode arrangement file.

barcode_sequences.description: Path to a custom barcode sequences file.

duplex_options.title: Duplex basecalling options
duplex_options.description: Duplex calling basecalls both template and complement strands together for higher accuracy.

duplex.help_text: Uses dorado duplex instead of dorado basecaller. Output is always BAM. Not compatible with --correct.

pairs_file.description: Path to a CSV file containing template/complement read ID pairs.
pairs_file.help_text: If not provided, Dorado auto-detects pairs from the POD5 files. Providing a pairs file speeds up processing when pairs are already known.

correction_options.title: Read error correction options
correction_options.description: Single-read error correction using the HERRO deep-learning algorithm.

correct.description: Run dorado correct on the basecalled reads.
correct.help_text: Requires >= 64 CPU cores, >= 256 GB RAM, and >= 32 GB GPU VRAM. Input reads should be >= 10 kbp with >= 30x coverage. Not compatible with --duplex.

paf_file.description: Pre-computed PAF alignment file for dorado correct (skips the internal alignment step).

performance_options.title: Performance tuning options
performance_options.description: GPU device selection, batching, and neural-network runner configuration for maximum throughput on large datasets.

device.help_text: null = Dorado auto-detects (uses GPU if available, otherwise CPU). 'cuda:all' uses every available NVIDIA GPU and is set automatically by the gpu profile. Specify individual indices (e.g. 'cuda:0,2') to exclude slower GPUs in heterogeneous systems.

batchsize.description: Number of chunks per inference batch. 0 = auto-tune from available GPU memory.
batchsize.help_text: Dorado benchmarks several batch sizes at startup and selects the fastest one. Only override if you need to reduce GPU memory usage.

chunksize.help_text: Smaller chunks reduce peak GPU memory usage; larger chunks may improve accuracy on long homopolymers.

overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks in samples (default 500).
overlap.help_text: Increasing overlap improves accuracy at chunk boundaries at the cost of redundant computation.

num_runners.description: Number of parallel neural-network runners per device.
num_runners.help_text: null = Dorado auto-selects. Increasing this value can improve GPU utilisation. Each runner consumes additional GPU memory.
